title: FULL ROBLOX Dynamic Head Guide Tutorial | Blender + Roblox Studio
license: No redistribution permission established; original analysis only.
review_notes: Full 18-minute caption text reviewed. Useful: edge-slide with UV correction, eye socket pockets, aligned lash/eyelid loops, clear facial bone names, empty groups and manual weights, full blink tests, neutral rest geometry, custom property export and landmark-aware cage repair.

The tutorial-specific 25 mandatory/50 maximum FACS claim is not the official minimum. Current head specification requires 17 named poses; do not tie price to a pose count. The 0.1 scale and scene hierarchy are template-specific.

A closed-mouth expression or displaced iris is not guaranteed to meet required jaw/mouth motion. Do not cross-wire independent FACS poses to imitate expressions: combined controls can double deformation. Never repair validation merely by adding names.

Third-party Discord/MediaFire templates need license/provenance and source inspection; preserve the official cage UV/topology. Deleting all existing bones/custom properties is only relevant to that disposable starting template and can destroy a working rig. No reproduced head or full visual review claimed.
